question.text: Let $f(x)$ be a differentiable function in $[2,7]$. If $f(2)=3$ and $f^{\prime}(x) \leq 5$ for all $x$ in $(2,7),$ then the maximum posaible value of $f(x)$ at $x=7$ is

solution.text:
Given, $\quad f^{\prime}(x) \leq 5$
$\frac{f(7)-f(2)}{x-2} \leq 5$
(by Lagrange mean value theorem] $\begin{array}{ll}\Rightarrow & \frac{f(7)-3}{7-2} \leq 5 \\ \Rightarrow & f(7) \leq 5(7-2)+3 \\ \therefore & f(7) \leq 28\end{array}$
